# Strategic Vision

_Generated by `ai-insights ledger sync` — do not edit directly._

## Short Term

Short-term goal is to make the whole project as easy as possible to set up and use by developers. Onboarding and daily usage must offer as little friction as possible.

## Mid Term

Mid-term goal, now that the project has transitioned from a private repository to a public one, is to improve the end-user documentation and to raise awareness on how critical persona design is for efficent and reliable agentic work.

## Long Term

Long-term goals are twofold:

**Primary goal** 
Iterative improvement of personas with the core "Personas First" philosophy: Focus on the essentials before agentic tools and IDEs with LLM-indepence by design. All integrated tools exist only to support the personas. Experience working with the project and continuous creative research ensure steady improvements.

**Secondary goal**
Make the project as reliable as possible on the target environments - both technically for the supported operating systems (Windows, Linux & MacOS) and operationally for the orchestrator headless workflow.
